name: rag-job-assistant
description: Run both apps from the repo root: npm run setup, then npm run dev

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
